name: Fabric Inspection
description: Inspect incoming fabric rolls for defects, stains, shrinkage, and quality before production

name: Fabric Relaxation
description: Allow fabric to relax and release manufacturing tension, especially for knitted fabrics

name: Pattern Making
description: Create garment patterns using CAD software and print them for production

name: Marker Planning
description: Optimize pattern layout on fabric to minimize waste using CAD marker software

name: Fusing
description: Bond interlining to specific fabric parts for stiffness and shape retention

name: Fabric Spreading
description: Spread fabric in multiple layers on the cutting table

name: Fabric Cutting
description: Cut fabric layers according to pattern pieces

name: Printing
description: Apply printed designs, patterns, or graphics to the fabric or garment

name: Embroidery
description: Stitch embroidered logos or decorative patterns onto the garment

name: Washing
description: Wash garments for effects such as stone wash, enzyme wash, or general garment wash

name: Drying
description: Dry garments after washing processes

name: Sewing
description: Join fabric pieces together using various industrial sewing machines

name: Buttonhole and Button Attachment
description: Create buttonholes and attach buttons for polos, shirts, trousers, and jackets

name: Zipper Attachment
description: Attach zippers to flies, pockets, jackets, hoodies, skirts, or dresses

name: Bartacking
description: Reinforce high-stress areas such as pockets, belt loops, and fly seams

name: Drawcord and Eyelet Attachment
description: Install eyelets and drawcords for hooded or waist-adjustable garments

name: Trimming
description: Trim excess threads, attach labels, and finish garment edges

name: Ironing
description: Press and iron the garment to remove wrinkles and achieve proper shape

name: Sandblasting
description: Apply abrasive treatment for distressed or vintage finishes

name: Quality Inspection
description: Inspect finished garment for defects, measurements, and quality standards

name: Folding
description: Fold garments to standard size for packaging

name: Packaging
description: Bag, pack, and seal garments in cartons for shipment
